Hello and welcome to a review of deep rock galactic . If you can't be bothered to read tldr 8.5/10 . 

- the Good - 

1) Generated maps each time . 

2) 4 very distinct classes each with their own strengths and weaknesses 

3) Free battlepass and very light monetization all around . 

4) Rock and Stone ! 

5) A pretty good variety of both missions and enemies . 

- the Bad - 

1) Mini bosses / Encounters are often times way more difficult by themselfs than the entire rest of the mission combined  .

- the Ugly - 

1) Updates are slow . 

2) Artstyle is very cartoon like . 

- Conclusion -
This is by far the best horde game i have played so far . 9/10 , Recommended for both horde fans and not .

Absolutely a phenomenal game. With different difficulty levels and the option to play solo or multiplayer, I can find the perfect mission after a long day or set myself up for a good challenge. Over 330 hours in and I have yet to grow tired of the mines. Rock and stone!!

You ever want to be a chaotic little person who has an equally unhealthy obsession with a man named Carl, rock and stone, minerals, and killing bugs? Well if so this is the game for you. Try to have fun as you try to play scout and are instantaneously blown up by a driller. Get automatically put into way to high of level of mission because your friends have already been playing the game for a few months or a year and you were the one stingy friend who didn't want to drop $20 on a game you thought looked "dumb" but in all reality this will be one of the best games you've ever played and you will look back regretting not buying it earlier and having those early game moments with your friends as you throw your brand new friend who just bought the game after being stingy into a level 5 dreadnought mission with shield disruption. If you've read this far into the review your either doing nothing and looking for funny game reviews on steam and got intrigued by this one or you are that stingy friend looking at the reviews of the game because your friends told you to buy it and your in denial about buying this game. BUY THE GAME. But with all seriousness this game is a masterpiece and is very fun and I don't regret any of the hours I've dumped into this game.
HIGHLY RECOMMEND 10/10
